proposal.quote: the strict position of neutrality called for by the letter of existing law ... the embargo on sales of American goods should be limited to those categories already defined as war materials
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports existing US neutrality legislation and an embargo limited to war materials, meeting the isolationist threshold of the Neutrality Act regime.

proposal.quote: the present state of conflict between Italy and Ethiopia ... the belligerent, designated by the League as the aggressor
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports Italy at war with Ethiopia and designated by the League as aggressor, meeting the estrangement-from-the-West condition.

proposal.quote: any legislation beyond that affecting arms and implements of war should be subject to the discretionary power of the President
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage presupposes existing non-discretionary legislation covering arms and implements of war, consistent with the Neutrality Act arms-embargo regime, while the author discusses only further discretionary extensions.

proposal.quote: in view of existing circumstances it would seem advisable to suspend at this time further consideration of trade agreement negotiations
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The US government's suspension of trade agreement negotiations with Italy 'in view of existing circumstances' reports a state of estrangement between Italy and the Western powers (following Ethiopia), meeting the estrangement threshold only by inference, hence low confidence.

proposal.quote: they saw a million heavily armed men on the march from Italy to Ethiopia. I stated the result was that at once the British Government had felt obliged to order its Navy to assemble posthaste, from every part of the earth, on the Mediterranean
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The italy_estranged threshold is Italy estranged from the West after Ethiopia; the passage reports British naval mobilization in response to Italy's army marching on Ethiopia, an explicit state of Western-Italian estrangement.

proposal.quote: Furthermore, he said that sitting in conference with Germany to negotiate a new naval agreement would be construed as a condonement of Germany’s violation of the Treaty of Versailles.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Reports a German violation of the Treaty of Versailles being treated as something negotiation would condone, i.e. a violation without enforcement, matching the eroded level.

proposal.quote: The British have intimated to us that it is essential that any qualitative agreement shall include Germany.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: States that the British insist any qualitative naval agreement include Germany, a policy of seeking a negotiated settlement with Germany rather than confrontation, meeting appease.

proposal.quote: the sanctions already in effect are rapidly curtailing Italy’s resources and ability to maintain the present effort
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports League sanctions in force against Italy, meeting the threshold for Italy estranged from the West after Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: Under the Anglo-German agreement giving Germany a 35 per cent ratio with the British fleet
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the Anglo-German Naval Agreement granting Germany a naval ratio, which under the threshold rule marks the Versailles/Locarno regime as eroded because naval rearmament beyond Part V was accepted without enforcement.

proposal.quote: the British were most anxious to do so as they had not been satisfied with the appeasement arising out of their naval agreement with Germany last year
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports London seeking to bring Germany into naval discussions and treating the earlier naval agreement as appeasement, i.e. a negotiated settlement premised on German aims being satisfiable; reported second-hand through a French official, so read as limited with low confidence.

proposal.quote: German rearmament up to the size declared on March 17 [16?] will not be completed until next year.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The dispatch reports German rearmament proceeding on the scale of the German declaration, i.e. a Versailles violation announced and unanswered by any guarantor force, with no report that the demilitarized zone has been reoccupied, so the regime remains eroded rather than dead.

proposal.quote: his Government is absolutely committed to great armament because Germany refused twice last autumn even to consider international arrangements as to armies and air forces...England will not make another peace proposal alone here
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The British Ambassador reports London adopting a great armament programme as a contingency measure because Germany refused to discuss international arms arrangements, while still leaving open further peace proposals (but not alone), which fits treating German aims as possibly beyond revision while still negotiating rather than as satisfiable by a negotiated settlement.

proposal.quote: There is real joy at the United States absolute neutrality.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The dispatch reports as a fact of the current situation that the United States stands on absolute neutrality, the Neutrality Act regime of mandatory embargo in force in February 1936.

proposal.quote: the British are insistent upon bringing Germany in, and the French themselves admit that this is most desirable
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The reported policy of London and Paris to bring Germany into a naval agreement treats German aims as satisfiable by negotiated settlement, the limited premise.

proposal.quote: French acquiescence in German participation would, in a measure, condone the violation of the military clauses of the Treaty of Versailles
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports that German naval rearmament violates Versailles military clauses and that French acquiescence would condone the violation, with no guarantor force and the Rhineland only threatened, so the treaty regime is eroded.

proposal.quote: The efficacy of financial and economic sanctions, plus the above absence of substantial Italian military success in Abyssinia, are regarded as marking the inevitable failure of Mussolini's adventure.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports League financial and economic sanctions as being applied against Italy, which is the precondition that keeps Italy estranged from the West under the threshold rule.

proposal.quote: The British continue to favor an approach to Germany whenever it can be determined that a reasonable and promising basis for negotiation has been evolved. ... it is realized here that some concessions to Germany must be made if there is to be any chance of political appeasement in Europe.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The reported British policy treats German aims as satisfiable by a negotiated general settlement involving concessions, meeting the limited level rather than uncertain or hegemonic.

proposal.quote: the only expansion in armament is in the air ... British foreign policy will be fundamentally based on the idea of temporization
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Armament is described as limited to air expansion, naval replacement and mechanization, with policy based on temporization and a search for settlement rather than a continental commitment, meeting the appease level.

proposal.quote: Great Britain would stand by Locarno but would refuse to make more precise the provisions of that pact and particularly in such a way as to alienate Germany and close the door to any possible appeasement with Germany
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: A ministerial statement (Eden) presents German aims as something a negotiated settlement, including a naval agreement with Germany as an original signatory, can satisfy, meeting the 'limited' rule that treats German aims as revision a general settlement can satisfy.

proposal.quote: Great Britain would stand by Locarno but would refuse to make more precise the provisions of that pact
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Britain keeps only its Locarno obligations, declines to make them more precise, and avoids alienating Germany in order to keep open 'appeasement', i.e. no commitment beyond Locarno and a policy seeking settlement, which is the 'appease' level.

proposal.quote: it was unlikely that the Germans had at the moment any warlike intentions, provided something could be done to satisfy her needs for raw materials and some territorial expansion for her excess population.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Sarraut's ministerial statement treats German aims as revision that a negotiated settlement satisfying raw-material and population needs can accommodate, meeting the limited threshold for belief_WEST.

proposal.quote: The French on the one hand, he personally believed, did not desire to form a military ring around Germany and that, on the other hand, it was unlikely that the Germans had at the moment any warlike intentions, provided something could be done to satisfy her needs for raw materials and some territorial expansion for her excess population.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Sarraut's statement that France did not seek to encircle Germany and could satisfy German needs through negotiation shows a policy seeking settlement, meeting the appease threshold for commit_WEST.

proposal.quote: the best preparation for a subsequent air agreement would be an unconditional naval agreement with Germany as a party to it
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Eden, a responsible minister, is reported to seek an unconditional agreement with Germany as the way forward, treating German rearmament as something a negotiated agreement can accommodate, which meets the 'limited' rule.

proposal.quote: it is essential that Germany be a party
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The British Government is reported to be pressing France to bring about a naval agreement with Germany, i.e. pursuing a settlement with no sign of a commitment to fight for a third state, which meets the 'appease' rule.

proposal.quote: until the question of sanctions is disposed of
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports that League sanctions against Italy are still in force and unresolved, the standing condition of Italian estrangement from the West after Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: continue in the League in spite of existing sanctions
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports League sanctions against Italy still in force, the post-Ethiopia estrangement from the West that defines the level.

proposal.quote: no definite political or military understanding exists between Germany and Italy
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The report explicitly finds no political or military understanding between Germany and Italy, so the Rome-Berlin alignment is absent.

proposal.quote: so long as sanctions are being applied against Italy
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports League sanctions as in fact being applied against Italy, the condition the rule gives for Italy's estrangement from the West, and the report of that fact counts even though the flag is unchanged (second-hand report by Monsell and Craigie).

proposal.quote: notwithstanding the political difficulties which had been raised with regard to their signing a naval agreement now
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports that political difficulties stand in the way of Italy signing a naval agreement with the Western powers, an explicit statement of Italy's estrangement from them (the threshold state, here reported without naming Ethiopia or the sanctions).

proposal.quote: sanctions are being applied against her with the threat of military measures
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Grandi's statement that sanctions are being applied against Italy with the threat of military measures reports the post-Ethiopia estrangement from the West, meeting the threshold for true.

proposal.quote: Grandi suggested that we might keep the Naval Conference going a few weeks as there was a possibility that the Abyssinian question might be settled or reach a stage which would enable Italy to proceed with the consummation of a naval agreement. ... Since it seems definite that the Italians will not now join in a naval agreement
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports that Italy's participation in the naval agreement with Britain, France, and the United States is blocked by the Abyssinian question, meeting the threshold for Italy being estranged from the West after Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: sanctions are being applied against Italy with the threat of military force
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports that sanctions are being applied against Italy with a military threat, meeting the threshold for Italy's estrangement from the West after Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: the sanctions now pending against Italy
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports League sanctions pending against Italy, the fact given as defending Italy's estrangement from the West after Ethiopia.
